dedupe_keys.name: idaes reusable process and power flowsheets

description: IDAES Examples is the IDAES consortium's maintained collection of executable process and power-system models in Jupyter notebooks. Documented flowsheets include methanol synthesis, carbon capture, supercritical power generation and natural-gas combined cycles. Inputs are flowsheet parameters, operating conditions and solver settings; outputs include calculated process streams and plant performance. Coverage is configurable plants and process units, not a geographic inventory. One NGCC example studies net output from 650 to 160 MW with carbon capture. Source is free under the repository's BSD-style licence, with separate solver dependencies. A limitation is that notebooks in the held directory are untested and discouraged for ordinary users; this record focuses on the documented examples. These reusable models can support infrastructure design and operating-scenario simulations. They use the previously drafted IDAES Integrated Platform (platform-idaes-integrated-platform). The collection is distinct from that general platform record. No notebook, solver or process dataset was executed or downloaded. DWSIM (model-dwsim-process-simulator) is related process-simulation software.
